supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends moderately beyond the outer corner of the visible right eye (viewer's left) following the curve of the temporal region.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned, pinkish muzzle/lower face and the dark-pigmented periocular and cheek regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of visible lower dentition and dark spotting/freckling on the skin of the upper muzzle.
